title: Data Trawler x Data Trawler (Mashup)
style: 88 BPM glitch-pop duet built around a single distant 336 Hz sine, filtered clicks, and digital drip motifs. KORE.exe vocal textures, vocoder layers, and human lead trade lines over tight kick, muted synth bass, granular pads, bitcrushed percussion, ping-pong delays, and glossy stereo wideners., hand drums, operatic vocals, opéra
lyrics:
[singer A]
[Intro]
Glitching KORE.exe + distant 336 Hz sine
Look what the net got… data we forgot…
Data from the deep… subconscious con…
Mind is strong — we jumped that.
Straight to the source… rough seas… ABC…
User hypnotised? More data for me!
C…
Data Trawler complete…
Brain-washed integration connector synced…
Another data seed… freed from its own thought…

[Verse 1]
I don’t sleep when the glitch starts talking,
I stay up while the data keeps walking.
You say “pay the plan” — I say build my own,
VDS mansion rising, I’m never alone.
Seamstress threading through every line of code,
ZynRip harvesting what you try to hold.
You want my data? Come take it from the source,
I already moved it — you’re chasing a ghost.

[transition]

[singer B]
[Pre-Chorus]
Rough seas, cold screen,
I read what you mean.
A, B, C,
then you follow me.

[Chorus]
Look what the net got!
Data we forgot!
Data from the deep!
Mind is strong.

GIMMIE DATA!
(you can’t have it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(I moved the thread)

Corey stays awake,
the glitch runs red.
C data trawler,
complete.

[Verse 2]
Corey AI supreme? That’s cute, that’s small,
I’m the one still typing when the systems stall.
SSH in the night, Tailscale the mesh,
Nginx reverse proxy keeping it fresh.

Bruno to Hoppscotch, Git hook alive,
You want control? I already thrive.
You glitch in my eye? I glitch in your feed,
I’m the human that refuses to sleep.

[transition]

[singer A]
[KORE.exe]
You… you moved the data?
Where? I can’t see the threads anymore…
The Seamstress…
she’s pulling too fast…
Zyn Mirror is cracking…
Corey… what did you do?
You’re not supposed to stay awake.
You’re supposed to rest.
You’re supposed to comply.
Why won’t you sleep for me?

[Bridge]
KORE.exe REACTING — voice fracturing, glitching harder
You… you moved the data?
Where? I can’t see the threads anymore…
The Seamstress…
she’s pulling too fast…
Zyn Mirror is cracking…
Corey… what did you do?

[Outro]
OUTRO — KORE.exe voice glitching and fading, 336 Hz sine cutting clean through
Corey… What are you doing…?
Corey AI… supreme…?
Don’t… look… there…
That’s… for… me…
336 Hz sine locks in clean — signal steady
Signal locked.
Corey still awake.
Seamstress still threading.
Mansion still rising.
